title: SignStop
description: A permission based plugin to prevent the placement of signs, for those who can't behave.
body:
![SignStop banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35179600022e063c70e09b2a77b58f9284115225.png)

A simple Spigot plugin for Minecraft 1.21.X that prevents players with the permission from placing **any type of sign**, including:

- Standing signs
- Wall signs
- Hanging signs
- Hanging wall signs

## Permissions

| Permission          | Description                                   |
|---------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| `signstop.prevent` | Prevents the player from placing any sign      |
